name: Japanese Trains
author: kaicardenas0618
description:
# Subway Builder Japanese Trains Subway Builder Japanese Trains is a mod for Subway Builder that adds trains from cities around Japan. All available train and track options are listed below. ## Track Types Each line has its own track type, named `{gauge}{line code}-{speed}`. Initial builds should be done with a track option where applicable, compatible tracks are listed at the end of the train name; e.g. JP N700A Shinkansen 1435JP is compatible with 1435JP-60, 1435JP-100, 1435JP-130, 1435JP-285, and 1435JP-320. Specific trains can be chosen afterwards in the route menu.
